d: Bihar ke navada jile ke nagar thana kshetr sthit purani bajar (thakurbari ke pas) se ek pramukh vyavsayi subodh kumar sandigdh paristhitiyon men pichhle ek saptah se lapta hain. vyavsayi ke is tarah achanak gayab ho jane se shahar ke vyapariyon aur sthaniy nivasiyon men dar va dahshat ka mahaul hai.
